# RecipeVoidResistPotion

`recipe`

Brew a void-resist potion from refined voidite shard dust and aethermite dust. Temporarily suppresses void-damage intake; required for extended void-rift operations.

> High-tier utility consumable; makes void zones survivable without VoidTouched profession

### craft

**Conditions:**
- Requires Alchemy: Expert
- Requires Arcane Forging: Journeyman
- Brewing room must be void-shielded; failure without shielding causes void burst
- One refined voidite shard and two aethermite dust yield one void-resist potion
